verifications.claim: The 2026 Masters is scheduled for April 9–12.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The 2026 Masters golf tournament runs from April 9-12, 2026."
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in multiple references with exact dates.

verifications.claim: Paramount+ offers full coverage of all rounds (Thursday-Sunday) of the 2026 Masters.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "The most comprehensive way to watch the 2026 Masters is on Paramount+, which will be live-streaming all the major moments from every round daily."
verifications.reasoning: References describe comprehensive coverage of major moments every round, but not explicitly 'full coverage' of all rounds; supports but less precise.

verifications.claim: Paramount+ includes early round action, third round, and final round coverage of the 2026 Masters.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Saturday/Sunday schedules: "12-2 p.m. Third Round (Paramount+)", "2-7 p.m. Third Round (CBS, Paramount+)", same for Fourth Round; mentioned for all rounds.
verifications.reasoning: Specific schedules confirm early (12-2pm), third, and final round coverage.

verifications.claim: ESPN+ offers live coverage of Featured Groups for the 2026 Masters.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "9:45 a.m.: Featured Groups, Third Round (ESPN+)"; "Featured Groups: ... (Masters.com, Masters App, Paramount+, Prime Video, ESPN App, DirecTV)".
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly lists ESPN+ / ESPN App for Featured Groups coverage.

verifications.claim: ESPN+ offers live coverage of featured holes (Amen Corner) for the 2026 Masters.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Featured Holes (Amen Corner, 11, 12 and 13): 11:45 a.m.-6 p.m. (Masters.com, Masters App, Paramount+, Prime Video, ESPN App, DirecTV)".
verifications.reasoning: ESPN App (ESPN+) provides Amen Corner featured holes coverage.

verifications.claim: Prime Video is new in 2026, offering exclusive, enhanced coverage of the first two rounds of the 2026 Masters.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "The first two days of the tournament are available on ... Prime Video"; "Prime Video: 1-3 p.m. ET"; "Amazon Prime Video debuts 'Inside Amen Corner' stream".
verifications.reasoning: Confirms Prime Video for first two rounds and 'debuts' implies new, but not explicitly 'exclusive, enhanced' or confirmed first time in 2026.

verifications.claim: Masters.com and the Masters App offer free streams of Featured Groups for the 2026 Masters.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Featured Groups: 10:15 a.m.-7 p.m. (Masters.com, Masters App, Paramount+, Prime Video, ESPN App, DirecTV)"; "you can watch ... for free on Masters.com and the Masters App."
verifications.reasoning: Directly states free Featured Groups streams on Masters.com and App.

verifications.claim: Masters.com and the Masters App offer free streams of featured holes (4, 5, 6; 15, 16) for the 2026 Masters.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Featured Holes (4, 5 and 6): 10:30 a.m.-3:30 p.m. (Masters.com, Masters App, ESPN App)"; "Featured Holes (15 and 16): 11:45 a.m.-7 p.m. (Masters.com, Masters App, ...)"; free on Masters.com/App.
verifications.reasoning: Exact holes and platforms match, with free access confirmed.

verifications.claim: Masters.com and the Masters App offer free streams of the main broadcast simulcast for the 2026 Masters.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Full Round 3 Stream: 12-7 p.m. (Masters.com, Masters App)"; "a single “Broadcast” stream running from 12-7 p.m. ET. It’s free of charge".
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly offers free full broadcast stream/simulcast.

verifications.claim: CBS and ESPN are available on YouTube TV, Hulu+ Live TV, and DirecTV.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "watch any broadcasts ... on CBS, CBS Sports Network, or ESPN on DirecTV or YouTube TV too."
verifications.reasoning: Confirms YouTube TV and DirecTV, but no mention of Hulu+ Live TV; partial support.

verifications.claim: Rounds 1 and 2 (April 9-10) of the 2026 Masters have streaming on ESPN+, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The first two days of the tournament are available on Paramount+, ... ESPN+, ... Prime Video"; "Prime Video: 1-3 p.m. ET ESPN/ESPN App: 3-7:30 p.m. ET".
verifications.reasoning: Directly lists streaming availability on these platforms for rounds 1 and 2.

verifications.claim: Rounds 3 and 4 (April 11-12) of the 2026 Masters have streaming on Paramount+ and ESPN+.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Saturday and Sunday coverage will stream on Paramount+ and ESPN+".

verifications.claim: CBS coverage is available for rounds 3 and 4 of the 2026 Masters.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "on CBS on Saturday and Sunday"; schedules show CBS for 2-7 p.m. Third/Fourth Rounds.
verifications.reasoning: Directly confirms CBS broadcast for rounds 3 and 4.

verifications.claim: Featured Groups and featured holes for the 2026 Masters are available daily via the Masters App, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2 weekend: Featured Groups/Holes on Masters App, Paramount+, Prime Video; R5 round 1: "Featured groups and featured holes coverage ... on Masters.com, the ESPN app, Paramount+ and Prime Video" (App implied).
verifications.reasoning: Supports daily availability across rounds on listed platforms.

verifications.claim: Final round streaming of the 2026 Masters is available on Paramount+ and CBS.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "2-7 p.m. Fourth Round (CBS, Paramount+)"; Paramount+ streams CBS simulcast.
verifications.reasoning: Paramount+ provides streaming of CBS final round coverage.
